claimed_scope: Implement the smallest deterministic Codex CLI native/adapted route planner/validator for Frankenstein 2.0. It consumes an explicit caller-supplied Codex host capability report plus release/state-lineage identities and maps concrete observed host surfaces onto semantic lifecycle roles without assuming Claude hook names or claiming unobserved installed capabilities. Matching names alone never count as firing evidence; missing required lifecycle primitives fail closed to DEGRADED/BLOCKED; canonical durable F2 state remains outside disposable Codex/plugin/cache roots; optional VPS/HCU attachment cannot be a prerequisite for baseline local boot. This workpackage plans and validates only: no filesystem writes, host probing, Codex/plugin installation, provider/model/tool calls, UnifiedDB mutation, real effects, physical-host installer credit or whole-system completion. Source/tests plus repository-hosted CI only. F2-WP-1101 owns generic host capability discovery/semantic ABI and F2-WP-1102 owns Claude Code routing; neither owned path may be modified by this claim.
